3️⃣ Enough time passes, you get so you depend on them.
   [해석] 세월이 충분히 흐르고 나면, 나중엔 이 벽에 완전히 의존하게 돼버려.

4️⃣ That's institutionalized. Outside, he was nothing, a nobody.
   [해석] 그게 바로 '길들여진다(institutionalized)'는 거야. 담장 밖 세상에서 그는 그저 아무것도 아닌 노인일 뿐이었지.

5️⃣ Brooks carved his name into the wooden beam: 'Brooks was here.'
   [해석] 브룩스는 여관방 나무 들보에 자신의 이름을 새겼어. '브룩스 여기 머물다 가다.'

audio_text: A shipment arrived from the senate containing second-hand books and records. Andy locked the guard in the bathroom and took over the PA system. He put the needle on the turntable, The Marriage of Figaro. Two Italian women singing like birds, soaring high above our gray prison. For the briefest of moments, every last man in Shawshank felt free.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 88]

1️⃣ A shipment arrived from the senate containing second-hand books and records.
   [해석] 의회로부터 헌책들과 낡은 레코드판이 담긴 상자가 도착했어.

2️⃣ Andy locked the guard in the bathroom and took over the PA system.
   [해석] 앤디는 당직 간수를 화장실에 가두고 교도소 방송실을 장악했지.

3️⃣ He put the needle on the turntable, The Marriage of Figaro.
   [해석] 그는 턴테이블 위에 바늘을 올려놓았어. 모차르트의 '피가로의 결혼'이었지.

4️⃣ Two Italian women singing like birds, soaring high above our gray prison.
   [해석] 두 이탈리아 여인의 노랫소리가 마치 새처럼, 잿빛 교도소 담장 위로 아득히 날아올랐어.

5️⃣ For the briefest of moments, every last man in Shawshank felt free.
   [해석] 그 짧은 순간 동안만큼은, 쇼생크의 모든 죄수가 온전한 자유를 느꼈지.

audio_text: Warden Norton gave Andy two weeks in solitary confinement for that stunt. Was it worth two weeks in the hole, Andy? Easiest time I ever did. I had Mr. Mozart with me. They can't get inside your head, Red. There's a place they can't touch. That place is hope. Hope is a good thing, maybe the best of things.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 89]

1️⃣ Warden Norton gave Andy two weeks in solitary confinement for that stunt.
   [해석] 노튼 소장은 그 대가로 앤디에게 2주간의 독방 감금 처벌을 내렸어.

2️⃣ Was it worth two weeks in the hole, Andy?
   [해석] 독방에서 2주나 썩을 만큼 가치가 있었나, 앤디?

3️⃣ Easiest time I ever did. I had Mr. Mozart with me.
   [해석] 내 생애 가장 수월한 시간이었어. 모차르트 선생이 나와 함께 있었거든.

4️⃣ They can't get inside your head, Red. There's a place they can't touch.
   [해석] 그들이 사람의 머릿속까지 들어올 순 없잖아, 레드. 그들이 결코 건드릴 수 없는 곳이 있어.

5️⃣ That place is hope. Hope is a good thing, maybe the best of things.
   [해석] 그곳이 바로 희망이야. 희망은 좋은 거지, 어쩌면 가장 좋은 것일지도 몰라.

audio_text: Warden Norton used prison labor for government road contracts. Bribes and kickbacks poured in from contractors in brown envelopes. Andy funneled the dirty money into clean bank accounts under a ghost identity. A young thief named Tommy Williams arrived with a story to tell. He knew the man who actually murdered Andy's wife and her lover.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 90]

1️⃣ Warden Norton used prison labor for government road contracts.
   [해석] 노튼 소장은 주정부 도로 공사에 죄수들의 무료 노동력을 동원했어.

2️⃣ Bribes and kickbacks poured in from contractors in brown envelopes.
   [해석] 업자들로부터 뇌물과 리베이트가 갈색 서류봉투에 가득 담겨 쏟아져 들어왔지.

3️⃣ Andy funneled the dirty money into clean bank accounts under a ghost identity.
   [해석] 앤디는 가상의 유령 신분을 만들어 그 더러운 돈을 깨끗한 은행 계좌들로 빼돌렸어.

4️⃣ A young thief named Tommy Williams arrived with a story to tell.
   [해석] 토미 윌리엄스라는 젊은 도둑이 들어왔고, 충격적인 이야기를 털어놓았지.

5️⃣ He knew the man who actually murdered Andy's wife and her lover.
   [해석] 그는 앤디의 아내와 애인을 실제로 살해한 진짜 범인을 알고 있었어.

audio_text: Andy begged Norton for a retrial based on Tommy's testimony. Norton refused coldly, terrified of losing his financial architect. Norton had Tommy called out to the yard in the middle of the night. Hadley shot Tommy four times from the guard tower. They claimed he was attempting to escape. The case was buried forever.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 91]

1️⃣ Andy begged Norton for a retrial based on Tommy's testimony.
   [해석] 앤디는 토미의 증언을 토대로 재심을 청구하게 해달라고 노튼에게 간청했어.

2️⃣ Norton refused coldly, terrified of losing his financial architect.
   [해석] 자신의 돈세탁 관리자를 잃는 것이 두려웠던 노튼은 차갑게 거절했지.

3️⃣ Norton had Tommy called out to the yard in the middle of the night.
   [해석] 노튼은 한밤중에 토미를 교도소 운동장으로 불러냈어.

4️⃣ Hadley shot Tommy four times from the guard tower.
   [해석] 그리고 하들리 간수가 감시탑 위에서 토미에게 네 발의 총탄을 난사했지.

5️⃣ They claimed he was attempting to escape. The case was buried forever.
   [해석] 그들은 녀석이 탈옥을 시도했다고 발표했어. 진실은 영원히 묻혀버렸지.

audio_text: Do you know what the Mexicans say about the Pacific? They say it has no memory. That's where I want to live. A little warm town called Zihuatanejo, right on the coast. I'd buy a worthless old boat and fix it up brand new. Get busy living, or get busy dying. That's the choice we have.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 92]

1️⃣ Do you know what the Mexicans say about the Pacific?
   [해석] 멕시코 사람들이 태평양에 대해 뭐라고 하는지 아나, 레드?

2️⃣ They say it has no memory. That's where I want to live.
   [해석] 과거를 기억하지 않는 곳이라고 하지. 난 바로 그곳에서 살고 싶어.

3️⃣ A little warm town called Zihuatanejo, right on the coast.
   [해석] 해안가에 자리 잡은 지후아타네호라는 작고 따뜻한 마을이야.

4️⃣ I'd buy a worthless old boat and fix it up brand new.
   [해석] 헐값의 낡은 보트를 한 척 사서 완전히 새것처럼 수리하는 거지.

5️⃣ Get busy living, or get busy dying. That's the choice we have.
   [해석] 바쁘게 살아가든가, 아니면 바쁘게 죽어가든가. 우리에게 남은 선택은 그것뿐이야.

audio_text: Red, promise me something if you ever get out of here. There's a big hayfield up in Buxton with a long stone wall. Under a big oak tree, look for a black obsidian rock. There's something buried there meant for you.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 93]

1️⃣ Red, promise me something if you ever get out of here.
   [해석] 레드, 만약 언젠가 이곳을 나가게 된다면 내게 하나만 약속해 줘.

2️⃣ There's a big hayfield up in Buxton with a long stone wall.
   [해석] 벅스턴에 가면 긴 돌담이 둘러쳐진 커다란 건초 밭이 하나 있어.

3️⃣ Under a big oak tree, look for a black obsidian rock.
   [해석] 커다란 오크나무 아래에서, 까맣고 매끄러운 흑요석 돌을 찾아봐.

4️⃣ There's something buried there meant for you.
   [해석] 그 아래 자네를 위해 묻어둔 물건이 있을 테니까.

audio_text: The next morning, cell block five fell dead silent. Andy Dufresne failed to respond to the morning roll call. Warden Norton stormed into the cell in sheer fury. He threw a chess piece at the Rita Hayworth poster on the wall. The stone tore straight through the poster, revealing a pitch-black tunnel.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 94]

1️⃣ The next morning, cell block five fell dead silent.
   [해석] 다음 날 아침, 제5 감방 구역은 쥐 죽은 듯 조용해졌어.

2️⃣ Andy Dufresne failed to respond to the morning roll call.
   [해석] 앤디 듀프레인이 아침 점호에 응답하지 않은 것이었지.

3️⃣ Warden Norton stormed into the cell in sheer fury.
   [해석] 노튼 소장이 머리끝까지 화가 난 채 감방 안으로 들이닥쳤어.

4️⃣ He threw a chess piece at the Rita Hayworth poster on the wall.
   [해석] 그는 분노에 차서 체스 말을 벽에 걸린 리타 헤이워스 포스터로 집어던졌지.

5️⃣ The stone tore straight through the poster, revealing a pitch-black tunnel.
   [해석] 돌은 포스터를 찢고 허공 속으로 날아갔고, 칠흑같이 어두운 굴이 드러났어.

audio_text: Andy had crawled through five hundred yards of foulness. A river of shit smelling of pure rot and despair. Five hundred yards, the length of five football fields. He came out clean on the other side, stripped into the rain. Raising his arms to the heavens, Andy Dufresne was a free man.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 95]

1️⃣ Andy had crawled through five hundred yards of foulness.
   [해석] 앤디는 오백 야드에 달하는 끔찍하고 더러운 오물 파이프를 기어 통과했어.

2️⃣ A river of shit smelling of pure rot and despair.
   [해석] 온갖 부패와 절망의 악취가 진동하는 분뇨의 강을 뚫고 지나간 거지.

3️⃣ Five hundred yards, the length of five football fields.
   [해석] 미식축구장 다섯 개에 달하는 그 길고 지독한 거리를.

4️⃣ He came out clean on the other side, stripped into the rain.
   [해석] 그는 마침내 반대편으로 깨끗하게 빠져나와 쏟아지는 빗속에서 옷을 벗어 던졌어.

5️⃣ Raising his arms to the heavens, Andy Dufresne was a free man.
   [해석] 하늘을 향해 두 팔을 번쩍 치켜든 앤디 듀프레인은 드디어 온전한 자유인이었지.

audio_text: The next morning, a distinguished gentleman walked into the Maine National Bank. He withdrew over three hundred and seventy thousand dollars in cash. He also mailed the ledger detailing Warden Norton's corruption to the daily newspaper. Police sirens wailed outside the prison gates as state troopers arrived. Warden Norton loaded his gun, put it under his chin, and pulled the trigger.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 96]

1️⃣ The next morning, a distinguished gentleman walked into the Maine National Bank.
   [해석] 다음 날 아침, 기품 있는 신사 한 명이 메인 국립은행 안으로 걸어 들어왔어.

2️⃣ He withdrew over three hundred and seventy thousand dollars in cash.
   [해석] 그는 37만 달러가 넘는 거액의 비자금을 현금으로 인출했지.

3️⃣ He also mailed the ledger detailing Warden Norton's corruption to the daily newspaper.
   [해석] 동시에 노튼 소장의 모든 부정부패가 기록된 비밀 장부를 일간 신문사로 우편 발송했어.

4️⃣ Police sirens wailed outside the prison gates as state troopers arrived.
   [해석] 주 경찰들이 들이닥치며 교도소 정문 밖으로 경찰 사이렌 소리가 요란하게 울려 퍼졌지.

5️⃣ Warden Norton loaded his gun, put it under his chin, and pulled the trigger.
   [해석] 노튼 소장은 총에 실탄을 장전해 턱 밑에 대고 방아쇠를 당겼어.

audio_text: After forty long years, my parole was finally approved. Forty years I've been asking myself if I'm rehabilitated. It's just a politician's word, meaningless to an old man. I walked out of those gates and felt lost in a world that got fast. I had to pack my bag and keep a promise I made to a friend.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 97]

1️⃣ After forty long years, my parole was finally approved.
   [해석] 장장 40년의 세월이 흐른 뒤, 마침내 나의 가석방이 승인되었어.

2️⃣ Forty years I've been asking myself if I'm rehabilitated.
   [해석] 40년 동안 난 내가 교화되었는지 스스로에게 끊임없이 물어왔지.

3️⃣ It's just a politician's word, meaningless to an old man.
   [해석] 그건 그저 정치가들이나 쓰는 말일 뿐, 늙은이에겐 아무 의미도 없지만 말이야.

4️⃣ I walked out of those gates and felt lost in a world that got fast.
   [해석] 난 교도소 정문을 걸어 나왔지만, 너무 빨라져 버린 세상 속에서 길을 잃은 기분이었어.

5️⃣ I had to pack my bag and keep a promise I made to a friend.
   [해석] 하지만 난 가방을 싸야 했어, 친구와 나눈 소중한 약속을 지키기 위해서.

audio_text: I hitched a ride to Buxton and walked until I found the field. The long stone wall stretched along the green grass under a clear blue sky. There stood the giant oak tree, standing tall just like Andy said. Underneath, I found the smooth black rock nestled among the stones. Beneath it lay a small tin box sealed tightly against the elements.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 98]

1️⃣ I hitched a ride to Buxton and walked until I found the field.
   [해석] 히치하이킹으로 벅스턴까지 가서 그 들판을 찾을 때까지 걸었지.

2️⃣ The long stone wall stretched along the green grass under a clear blue sky.
   [해석] 청명한 푸른 하늘 아래, 긴 돌담이 푸른 초원을 따라 길게 뻗어 있었어.

3️⃣ There stood the giant oak tree, standing tall just like Andy said.
   [해석] 그곳에 앤디의 말 그대로 거대한 오크나무 한 그루가 우뚝 서 있었어.

4️⃣ Underneath, I found the smooth black rock nestled among the stones.
   [해석] 나무 밑 돌 틈 사이에 다소곳이 자리 잡은 매끄러운 흑요석 돌을 찾아냈지.

5️⃣ Beneath it lay a small tin box sealed tightly against the elements.
   [해석] 돌 아래에는 빗물이 들어가지 않도록 단단히 밀봉된 작은 틴케이스가 묻혀 있었어.

audio_text: Inside the box was an envelope of cash and a letter from Andy. Dear Red, if you're reading this, you've gotten out. Remember, Red, hope is a good thing, maybe the best of things. And no good thing ever dies. I will be keeping an eye out for you. Your friend, Andy.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 99]

1️⃣ Inside the box was an envelope of cash and a letter from Andy.
   [해석] 상자 안에는 두툼한 현금 봉투와 앤디가 보낸 편지 한 통이 들어 있었지.

2️⃣ Dear Red, if you're reading this, you've gotten out.
   [해석] 친애하는 레드, 자네가 이 글을 읽고 있다면 무사히 밖으로 나왔겠군요.

3️⃣ Remember, Red, hope is a good thing, maybe the best of things.
   [해석] 기억해요, 레드. 희망은 좋은 것입니다. 어쩌면 세상에서 가장 좋은 것일지도 몰라요.

4️⃣ And no good thing ever dies.
   [해석] 그리고 그 어떤 좋은 것도 결코 영원히 죽지 않습니다.

5️⃣ I will be keeping an eye out for you. Your friend, Andy.
   [해석] 자네가 찾아오기를 손꼽아 기다리고 있겠습니다. 자네의 친구, 앤디로부터.

audio_text: I find I'm so excited I can barely sit still or hold a thought in my head. I think it is the excitement only a free man can feel. A free man at the start of a long journey whose conclusion is uncertain. I hope I can make it across the border. I hope to see my friend and shake his hand. I hope the Pacific is as blue as it has been in my dreams. I hope.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 100]

1️⃣ I find I'm so excited I can barely sit still or hold a thought in my head.
   [해석] 얼마나 가슴이 벅차오르는지 가만히 앉아 있을 수도, 생각을 정리할 수도 없더군.

2️⃣ I think it is the excitement only a free man can feel.
   [해석] 오직 자유로운 인간만이 느낄 수 있는 환희와 설렘이라고 생각해.

3️⃣ A free man at the start of a long journey whose conclusion is uncertain.
   [해석] 그 끝을 알 수 없는 기나긴 여정의 출발선에 선 온전한 자유인.

4️⃣ I hope I can make it across the border. I hope to see my friend and shake his hand.
   [해석] 부디 무사히 국경을 넘을 수 있기를 희망한다. 내 오랜 친구를 만나 그 손을 꼭 잡을 수 있기를 희망한다.

5️⃣ I hope the Pacific is as blue as it has been in my dreams. I hope.
   [해석] 태평양이 내 꿈속에서처럼 언제나 눈부시게 푸르기를 희망한다. 나는 희망한다.

audio_text: Mr. Dufresne, describe the confrontation you had with your wife the night she was murdered. It was very bitter. She said she was glad I knew, that she hated all the sneaking around. She said she wanted a divorce in Reno. What was your response? I told her I would not grant one. I'll see you in hell before I see you in Reno.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 101]

1️⃣ Mr. Dufresne, describe the confrontation you had with your wife the night she was murdered.
   [해석] 듀프레인 씨, 아내가 살해당하던 날 밤 있었던 말다툼에 대해 진술해 주십시오.

2️⃣ It was very bitter. She said she was glad I knew, that she hated all the sneaking around.
   [해석] 매우 격렬했습니다. 아내는 내가 알게 되어 차라리 후련하다고, 몰래 숨어다니는 짓에 진절머리가 났다고 했습니다.

3️⃣ She said she wanted a divorce in Reno.
   [해석] 아내는 리노에 가서 이혼하길 원한다고 말했습니다.

4️⃣ What was your response?
   [해석] 당신의 반응은 어땠습니까?

5️⃣ I told her I would not grant one. I'll see you in hell before I see you in Reno.
   [해석] 이혼해 줄 수 없다고 했습니다. 리노에 가느니 지옥에나 가라고 했죠.

audio_text: After she packed her bags and left, what did you do? I went into the kitchen and did some drinking. Later I decided to take a drive. I went to the cottage to confront them. They weren't there, so I parked the car and waited.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 102]

1️⃣ After she packed her bags and left, what did you do?
   [해석] 아내가 짐을 싸서 떠난 후, 당신은 무엇을 했습니까?

2️⃣ I went into the kitchen and did some drinking.
   [해석] 부엌으로 가서 술을 좀 마셨습니다.

3️⃣ Later I decided to take a drive.
   [해석] 그러다 나중에 차를 몰고 나갔습니다.

4️⃣ I went to the cottage to confront them.
   [해석] 두 사람을 담판 짓기 위해 별장으로 갔습니다.

5️⃣ They weren't there, so I parked the car and waited.
   [해석] 그들이 없어서, 차를 세워두고 기다렸습니다.

audio_text: When they arrived, did you go inside? No, I was sobering up. I realized it was pointless. I got back in my car and drove home. And what did you do with the revolver you bought just days before? I threw it into the Royal River. I feel very strongly about that.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 103]

1️⃣ When they arrived, did you go inside?
   [해석] 그들이 도착했을 때, 안으로 들어갔습니까?

2️⃣ No, I was sobering up. I realized it was pointless.
   [해석] 아닙니다, 술이 깨고 있었습니다. 부질없는 짓이라는 걸 깨달았죠.

3️⃣ I got back in my car and drove home.
   [해석] 다시 차에 올라타 집으로 운전해 돌아왔습니다.

4️⃣ And what did you do with the revolver you bought just days before?
   [해석] 그렇다면 며칠 전에 구입한 그 리볼버 권총은 어떻게 했습니까?

5️⃣ I threw it into the Royal River. I feel very strongly about that.
   [해석] 로열 강에 던져 버렸습니다. 그 점은 분명히 기억합니다.

audio_text: The police dragged that river for three days and found no weapon. You strike me as a particularly cold and remorseless man, Mr. Dufresne. It chills my blood just to look at you. By the power vested in me by the state of Maine, I sentence you to two life sentences. Back to back, one for each of your victims.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 104]

1️⃣ The police dragged that river for three days and found no weapon.
   [해석] 경찰이 사흘 동안 그 강을 샅샅이 뒤졌으나 총기는 발견되지 않았습니다.

2️⃣ You strike me as a particularly cold and remorseless man, Mr. Dufresne.
   [해석] 듀프레인 씨, 당신은 유독 차갑고 죄책감이 없는 사람처럼 보입니다.

3️⃣ It chills my blood just to look at you.
   [해석] 당신을 쳐다보는 것만으로도 소름이 끼치는군요.

4️⃣ By the power vested in me by the state of Maine, I sentence you to two life sentences.
   [해석] 메인주가 부여한 권한으로, 피고에게 무기징역 2회를 선고합니다.

5️⃣ Back to back, one for each of your victims.
   [해석] 각 희생자에 대해 하나씩, 연속으로 복역하도록 판결합니다.

audio_text: There's a guy like me in every state and federal prison in America. I'm the guy who can get it for you. Cigarettes, a bag of weed, a bottle of brandy to celebrate your kid's graduation. Yes, sir, I'm a regular Sears and Roebuck. I was convicted of murder when I was just twenty years old.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 105]

2️⃣ I'm the guy who can get it for you.

   [해석] 담배, 대마초 한 봉지, 자식의 졸업을 축하하기 위한 브랜디 한 병까지.

4️⃣ Yes, sir, I'm a regular Sears and Roebuck.
   [해석] 그렇고말고, 난 교도소 안의 걸어 다니는 백화점이었지.

5️⃣ I was convicted of murder when I was just twenty years old.
   [해석] 난 고작 스무 살 나이에 살인죄로 유죄 판결을 받았어.

audio_text: I remember my first night in Shawshank like it was yesterday. The new arrivals are always frightened half to death. They march you in naked as the day you were born. Louse powder stinging your skin and eyes. You're locked in a dark cage and suddenly realize this is your new life.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 106]

1️⃣ I remember my first night in Shawshank like it was yesterday.
   [해석] 쇼생크에서의 첫날밤이 마치 어제 일처럼 생생하게 기억나.

2️⃣ The new arrivals are always frightened half to death.
   [해석] 새로 들어온 신참들은 항상 거의 반쯤 넋이 나가 겁에 질려 있지.

3️⃣ They march you in naked as the day you were born.
   [해석] 세상에 태어난 첫날처럼 홀딱 벗겨진 채로 걸어가게 해.

4️⃣ Louse powder stinging your skin and eyes.
   [해석] 이 잡는 소독약 가루가 피부와 눈을 사정없이 따갑게 찌르지.

5️⃣ You're locked in a dark cage and suddenly realize this is your new life.
   [해석] 어두운 쇠창살 방에 갇히고 나면, 비로소 이것이 자신의 새로운 삶임을 깨닫게 돼.

audio_text: I understand you're a man who knows how to get things. I've been known to locate certain things from time to time. What do you want, Dufresne? A hammer? What kind? A rock hammer, about six or seven inches long, for shaping minerals. If you want a toothbrush, I can get that. A rock hammer takes a little more doing.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 107]

1️⃣ I understand you're a man who knows how to get things.
   [해석] 원하는 물건을 구할 줄 아는 분이라고 들었습니다.

2️⃣ I've been known to locate certain things from time to time.
   [해석] 이따금씩 몇 가지 물건들을 구해다 주곤 하지.

3️⃣ What do you want, Dufresne? A hammer? What kind?
   [해석] 뭘 원하는데, 듀프레인? 망치라고? 어떤 종류?

4️⃣ A rock hammer, about six or seven inches long, for shaping minerals.
   [해석] 돌망치입니다. 광물을 다듬기 위한 6~7인치 정도 크기예요.

5️⃣ If you want a toothbrush, I can get that. A rock hammer takes a little more doing.
   [해석] 칫솔이라면 당장 구해줄 수 있지만, 돌망치는 손이 좀 더 많이 가겠는데.

audio_text: Outdoor detail in the springtime is a rare privilege. We were spreading bubbling black tar on the plate factory roof. Captain Hadley was complaining about the taxes on an inheritance. The government takes half of everything, he cursed under his breath. That's when Andy Dufresne stepped right up to the line.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 108]

1️⃣ Outdoor detail in the springtime is a rare privilege.
   [해석] 화창한 봄날의 야외 작업은 교도소에서 드문 특권이지.

2️⃣ We were spreading bubbling black tar on the plate factory roof.
   [해석] 우리는 번호판 공장 지붕 위에 펄펄 끓는 검은 타르를 바르고 있었어.

3️⃣ Captain Hadley was complaining about the taxes on an inheritance.
   [해석] 하들리 간수장은 형제에게 물려받은 유산 상속세 때문에 투덜대고 있었지.

4️⃣ The government takes half of everything, he cursed under his breath.
   [해석] 정부 놈들이 절반이나 뜯어간다고 욕설을 내뱉더군.

5️⃣ That's when Andy Dufresne stepped right up to the line.
   [해석] 바로 그때, 앤디 듀프레인이 성큼 그 앞으로 걸어 나갔어.

audio_text: Mr. Hadley, do you trust your wife? What did you say to me, convict? You want to be tossed off this roof? If you trust her, you can give that thirty-five thousand dollars to her tax-free. The IRS allows a one-time gift to a spouse without paying a single dime. You need someone to set up the paperwork, and I can do it for you.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 109]

1️⃣ Mr. Hadley, do you trust your wife?
   [해석] 하들리 씨, 아내분을 믿으십니까?

2️⃣ What did you say to me, convict? You want to be tossed off this roof?
   [해석] 뭐라고 지껄였냐, 죄수 놈아? 이 지붕에서 내던져지고 싶어?

3️⃣ If you trust her, you can give that thirty-five thousand dollars to her tax-free.
   [해석] 아내분을 믿으신다면, 그 3만 5천 달러를 한 푼의 세금도 없이 아내 명의로 넘길 수 있습니다.

4️⃣ The IRS allows a one-time gift to a spouse without paying a single dime.
   [해석] 국세청 규정상 배우자에게 하는 일회성 증여는 단 1센트의 세금도 물리지 않거든요.

5️⃣ You need someone to set up the paperwork, and I can do it for you.
   [해석] 서류 작업을 해줄 사람이 필요하실 텐데, 제가 대신해 드릴 수 있습니다.

audio_text: All I ask is three beers apiece for each of my co-workers. A man working outdoors feels more like a man if he can have a bottle of suds. And so that's how it came to pass. We sat and drank with the sun on our shoulders and felt like free men. Andy sat apart from us, squinting against the light, smiling to himself.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 110]

1️⃣ All I ask is three beers apiece for each of my co-workers.
   [해석] 제가 부탁드리는 대가는 여기 일하는 동료들에게 차가운 맥주 세 병씩을 주시는 것뿐입니다.

2️⃣ A man working outdoors feels more like a man if he can have a bottle of suds.
   [해석] 야외에서 땀 흘려 일하는 남자는 시원한 맥주 한 잔을 마실 수 있을 때 비로소 사람답게 느끼는 법이니까요.

3️⃣ And so that's how it came to pass.
   [해석] 그렇게 해서 그 일이 실제로 벌어졌지.

4️⃣ We sat and drank with the sun on our shoulders and felt like free men.
   [해석] 우리는 어깨 위로 따스한 햇살을 받으며 앉아 마치 자유인이 된 기분으로 맥주를 마셨어.

5️⃣ Andy sat apart from us, squinting against the light, smiling to himself.
   [해석] 앤디는 우리와 조금 떨어진 채, 햇빛을 찌푸려 보며 혼자 조용히 미소 짓고 있었지.

audio_text: Andy was reassigned to the prison library assisting old Brooks Hatlen. It was really just a cover for doing taxes for the guards. Word spreads fast, and soon guards from other prisons were coming too. Andy began writing letters to the state senate requesting book funds. He wrote a letter a week for six long years without giving up.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 111]

1️⃣ Andy was reassigned to the prison library assisting old Brooks Hatlen.
   [해석] 앤디는 늙은 브룩스 영감을 돕는 교도소 도서관 보조로 보직이 변경되었어.

2️⃣ It was really just a cover for doing taxes for the guards.
   [해석] 사실 그건 간수들의 세금 계산을 도맡아 해주기 위한 구실에 불과했지.

3️⃣ Word spreads fast, and soon guards from other prisons were coming too.
   [해석] 소문은 금세 퍼졌고, 머지않아 다른 교도소의 간수들까지 찾아오기 시작했어.

4️⃣ Andy began writing letters to the state senate requesting book funds.
   [해석] 앤디는 주 의회에 도서관 지원금을 요청하는 편지를 매주 쓰기 시작했지.

5️⃣ He wrote a letter a week for six long years without giving up.
   [해석] 포기하지 않고 장장 6년 동안 매주 한 통씩 편지를 써 보냈어.

audio_text: Brooks Hatlen spent fifty years behind these walls. These walls are funny. First you hate them, then you get used to them. Enough time passes, you get so you depend on them. That's institutionalized. Outside, he was nothing, a nobody. Brooks carved his name into the wooden beam: 'Brooks was here.'
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 112]

1️⃣ Brooks Hatlen spent fifty years behind these walls.
   [해석] 브룩스 헤이틀런은 이 담장 안에서 무려 50년의 세월을 보냈어.

2️⃣ These walls are funny. First you hate them, then you get used to them.
   [해석] 이 벽이란 게 참 묘하지. 처음엔 증오하다가도, 점차 익숙해져.

3️⃣ Enough time passes, you get so you depend on them.
   [해석] 세월이 충분히 흐르고 나면, 나중엔 이 벽에 완전히 의존하게 돼버려.

4️⃣ That's institutionalized. Outside, he was nothing, a nobody.
   [해석] 그게 바로 '길들여진다(institutionalized)'는 거야. 담장 밖 세상에서 그는 그저 아무것도 아닌 노인일 뿐이었지.

5️⃣ Brooks carved his name into the wooden beam: 'Brooks was here.'
   [해석] 브룩스는 여관방 나무 들보에 자신의 이름을 새겼어. '브룩스 여기 머물다 가다.'

audio_text: A shipment arrived from the senate containing second-hand books and records. Andy locked the guard in the bathroom and took over the PA system. He put the needle on the turntable, The Marriage of Figaro. Two Italian women singing like birds, soaring high above our gray prison. For the briefest of moments, every last man in Shawshank felt free.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 113]

2️⃣ Andy locked the guard in the bathroom and took over the PA system.
   [해석] 앤디는 당직 간수를 화장실에 가두고 교도소 방송실을 장악했지.

3️⃣ He put the needle on the turntable, The Marriage of Figaro.
   [해석] 그는 턴테이블 위에 바늘을 올려놓았어. 모차르트의 '피가로의 결혼'이었지.

4️⃣ Two Italian women singing like birds, soaring high above our gray prison.
   [해석] 두 이탈리아 여인의 노랫소리가 마치 새처럼, 잿빛 교도소 담장 위로 아득히 날아올랐어.

5️⃣ For the briefest of moments, every last man in Shawshank felt free.
   [해석] 그 짧은 순간 동안만큼은, 쇼생크의 모든 죄수가 온전한 자유를 느꼈지.

audio_text: Warden Norton gave Andy two weeks in solitary confinement for that stunt. Was it worth two weeks in the hole, Andy? Easiest time I ever did. I had Mr. Mozart with me. They can't get inside your head, Red. There's a place they can't touch. That place is hope. Hope is a good thing, maybe the best of things.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 114]

1️⃣ Warden Norton gave Andy two weeks in solitary confinement for that stunt.
   [해석] 노튼 소장은 그 대가로 앤디에게 2주간의 독방 감금 처벌을 내렸어.

2️⃣ Was it worth two weeks in the hole, Andy?
   [해석] 독방에서 2주나 썩을 만큼 가치가 있었나, 앤디?

3️⃣ Easiest time I ever did. I had Mr. Mozart with me.
   [해석] 내 생애 가장 수월한 시간이었어. 모차르트 선생이 나와 함께 있었거든.

4️⃣ They can't get inside your head, Red. There's a place they can't touch.
   [해석] 그들이 사람의 머릿속까지 들어올 순 없잖아, 레드. 그들이 결코 건드릴 수 없는 곳이 있어.

5️⃣ That place is hope. Hope is a good thing, maybe the best of things.
   [해석] 그곳이 바로 희망이야. 희망은 좋은 거지, 어쩌면 가장 좋은 것일지도 몰라.

audio_text: Warden Norton used prison labor for government road contracts. Bribes and kickbacks poured in from contractors in brown envelopes. Andy funneled the dirty money into clean bank accounts under a ghost identity. A young thief named Tommy Williams arrived with a story to tell. He knew the man who actually murdered Andy's wife and her lover.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 115]

1️⃣ Warden Norton used prison labor for government road contracts.
   [해석] 노튼 소장은 주정부 도로 공사에 죄수들의 무료 노동력을 동원했어.

2️⃣ Bribes and kickbacks poured in from contractors in brown envelopes.
   [해석] 업자들로부터 뇌물과 리베이트가 갈색 서류봉투에 가득 담겨 쏟아져 들어왔지.

3️⃣ Andy funneled the dirty money into clean bank accounts under a ghost identity.
   [해석] 앤디는 가상의 유령 신분을 만들어 그 더러운 돈을 깨끗한 은행 계좌들로 빼돌렸어.

4️⃣ A young thief named Tommy Williams arrived with a story to tell.
   [해석] 토미 윌리엄스라는 젊은 도둑이 들어왔고, 충격적인 이야기를 털어놓았지.

5️⃣ He knew the man who actually murdered Andy's wife and her lover.
   [해석] 그는 앤디의 아내와 애인을 실제로 살해한 진짜 범인을 알고 있었어.

audio_text: Andy begged Norton for a retrial based on Tommy's testimony. Norton refused coldly, terrified of losing his financial architect. Norton had Tommy called out to the yard in the middle of the night. Hadley shot Tommy four times from the guard tower. They claimed he was attempting to escape. The case was buried forever.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 116]

1️⃣ Andy begged Norton for a retrial based on Tommy's testimony.
   [해석] 앤디는 토미의 증언을 토대로 재심을 청구하게 해달라고 노튼에게 간청했어.

2️⃣ Norton refused coldly, terrified of losing his financial architect.
   [해석] 자신의 돈세탁 관리자를 잃는 것이 두려웠던 노튼은 차갑게 거절했지.

3️⃣ Norton had Tommy called out to the yard in the middle of the night.
   [해석] 노튼은 한밤중에 토미를 교도소 운동장으로 불러냈어.

4️⃣ Hadley shot Tommy four times from the guard tower.
   [해석] 그리고 하들리 간수가 감시탑 위에서 토미에게 네 발의 총탄을 난사했지.

5️⃣ They claimed he was attempting to escape. The case was buried forever.
   [해석] 그들은 녀석이 탈옥을 시도했다고 발표했어. 진실은 영원히 묻혀버렸지.

audio_text: Do you know what the Mexicans say about the Pacific? They say it has no memory. That's where I want to live. A little warm town called Zihuatanejo, right on the coast. I'd buy a worthless old boat and fix it up brand new. Get busy living, or get busy dying. That's the choice we have.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 117]

1️⃣ Do you know what the Mexicans say about the Pacific?
   [해석] 멕시코 사람들이 태평양에 대해 뭐라고 하는지 아나, 레드?

2️⃣ They say it has no memory. That's where I want to live.
   [해석] 과거를 기억하지 않는 곳이라고 하지. 난 바로 그곳에서 살고 싶어.

3️⃣ A little warm town called Zihuatanejo, right on the coast.
   [해석] 해안가에 자리 잡은 지후아타네호라는 작고 따뜻한 마을이야.

4️⃣ I'd buy a worthless old boat and fix it up brand new.
   [해석] 헐값의 낡은 보트를 한 척 사서 완전히 새것처럼 수리하는 거지.

5️⃣ Get busy living, or get busy dying. That's the choice we have.
   [해석] 바쁘게 살아가든가, 아니면 바쁘게 죽어가든가. 우리에게 남은 선택은 그것뿐이야.

audio_text: Red, promise me something if you ever get out of here. There's a big hayfield up in Buxton with a long stone wall. Under a big oak tree, look for a black obsidian rock. There's something buried there meant for you.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 118]

1️⃣ Red, promise me something if you ever get out of here.
   [해석] 레드, 만약 언젠가 이곳을 나가게 된다면 내게 하나만 약속해 줘.

2️⃣ There's a big hayfield up in Buxton with a long stone wall.
   [해석] 벅스턴에 가면 긴 돌담이 둘러쳐진 커다란 건초 밭이 하나 있어.

3️⃣ Under a big oak tree, look for a black obsidian rock.
   [해석] 커다란 오크나무 아래에서, 까맣고 매끄러운 흑요석 돌을 찾아봐.

4️⃣ There's something buried there meant for you.
   [해석] 그 아래 자네를 위해 묻어둔 물건이 있을 테니까.

audio_text: The next morning, cell block five fell dead silent. Andy Dufresne failed to respond to the morning roll call. Warden Norton stormed into the cell in sheer fury. He threw a chess piece at the Rita Hayworth poster on the wall. The stone tore straight through the poster, revealing a pitch-black tunnel.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 119]

1️⃣ The next morning, cell block five fell dead silent.
   [해석] 다음 날 아침, 제5 감방 구역은 쥐 죽은 듯 조용해졌어.

2️⃣ Andy Dufresne failed to respond to the morning roll call.
   [해석] 앤디 듀프레인이 아침 점호에 응답하지 않은 것이었지.

3️⃣ Warden Norton stormed into the cell in sheer fury.
   [해석] 노튼 소장이 머리끝까지 화가 난 채 감방 안으로 들이닥쳤어.

4️⃣ He threw a chess piece at the Rita Hayworth poster on the wall.
   [해석] 그는 분노에 차서 체스 말을 벽에 걸린 리타 헤이워스 포스터로 집어던졌지.

5️⃣ The stone tore straight through the poster, revealing a pitch-black tunnel.
   [해석] 돌은 포스터를 찢고 허공 속으로 날아갔고, 칠흑같이 어두운 굴이 드러났어.

audio_text: Andy had crawled through five hundred yards of foulness. A river of shit smelling of pure rot and despair. Five hundred yards, the length of five football fields. He came out clean on the other side, stripped into the rain. Raising his arms to the heavens, Andy Dufresne was a free man.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 120]

1️⃣ Andy had crawled through five hundred yards of foulness.
   [해석] 앤디는 오백 야드에 달하는 끔찍하고 더러운 오물 파이프를 기어 통과했어.

2️⃣ A river of shit smelling of pure rot and despair.
   [해석] 온갖 부패와 절망의 악취가 진동하는 분뇨의 강을 뚫고 지나간 거지.

3️⃣ Five hundred yards, the length of five football fields.
   [해석] 미식축구장 다섯 개에 달하는 그 길고 지독한 거리를.

4️⃣ He came out clean on the other side, stripped into the rain.
   [해석] 그는 마침내 반대편으로 깨끗하게 빠져나와 쏟아지는 빗속에서 옷을 벗어 던졌어.

5️⃣ Raising his arms to the heavens, Andy Dufresne was a free man.
   [해석] 하늘을 향해 두 팔을 번쩍 치켜든 앤디 듀프레인은 드디어 온전한 자유인이었지.

audio_text: The next morning, a distinguished gentleman walked into the Maine National Bank. He withdrew over three hundred and seventy thousand dollars in cash. He also mailed the ledger detailing Warden Norton's corruption to the daily newspaper. Police sirens wailed outside the prison gates as state troopers arrived. Warden Norton loaded his gun, put it under his chin, and pulled the trigger.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 121]

1️⃣ The next morning, a distinguished gentleman walked into the Maine National Bank.
   [해석] 다음 날 아침, 기품 있는 신사 한 명이 메인 국립은행 안으로 걸어 들어왔어.

2️⃣ He withdrew over three hundred and seventy thousand dollars in cash.
   [해석] 그는 37만 달러가 넘는 거액의 비자금을 현금으로 인출했지.

3️⃣ He also mailed the ledger detailing Warden Norton's corruption to the daily newspaper.
   [해석] 동시에 노튼 소장의 모든 부정부패가 기록된 비밀 장부를 일간 신문사로 우편 발송했어.

4️⃣ Police sirens wailed outside the prison gates as state troopers arrived.
   [해석] 주 경찰들이 들이닥치며 교도소 정문 밖으로 경찰 사이렌 소리가 요란하게 울려 퍼졌지.

5️⃣ Warden Norton loaded his gun, put it under his chin, and pulled the trigger.
   [해석] 노튼 소장은 총에 실탄을 장전해 턱 밑에 대고 방아쇠를 당겼어.

audio_text: After forty long years, my parole was finally approved. Forty years I've been asking myself if I'm rehabilitated. It's just a politician's word, meaningless to an old man. I walked out of those gates and felt lost in a world that got fast. I had to pack my bag and keep a promise I made to a friend.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 122]

1️⃣ After forty long years, my parole was finally approved.
   [해석] 장장 40년의 세월이 흐른 뒤, 마침내 나의 가석방이 승인되었어.

2️⃣ Forty years I've been asking myself if I'm rehabilitated.
   [해석] 40년 동안 난 내가 교화되었는지 스스로에게 끊임없이 물어왔지.

3️⃣ It's just a politician's word, meaningless to an old man.
   [해석] 그건 그저 정치가들이나 쓰는 말일 뿐, 늙은이에겐 아무 의미도 없지만 말이야.

4️⃣ I walked out of those gates and felt lost in a world that got fast.
   [해석] 난 교도소 정문을 걸어 나왔지만, 너무 빨라져 버린 세상 속에서 길을 잃은 기분이었어.

5️⃣ I had to pack my bag and keep a promise I made to a friend.
   [해석] 하지만 난 가방을 싸야 했어, 친구와 나눈 소중한 약속을 지키기 위해서.

audio_text: I hitched a ride to Buxton and walked until I found the field. The long stone wall stretched along the green grass under a clear blue sky. There stood the giant oak tree, standing tall just like Andy said. Underneath, I found the smooth black rock nestled among the stones. Beneath it lay a small tin box sealed tightly against the elements.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 123]

1️⃣ I hitched a ride to Buxton and walked until I found the field.
   [해석] 히치하이킹으로 벅스턴까지 가서 그 들판을 찾을 때까지 걸었지.

2️⃣ The long stone wall stretched along the green grass under a clear blue sky.
   [해석] 청명한 푸른 하늘 아래, 긴 돌담이 푸른 초원을 따라 길게 뻗어 있었어.

3️⃣ There stood the giant oak tree, standing tall just like Andy said.
   [해석] 그곳에 앤디의 말 그대로 거대한 오크나무 한 그루가 우뚝 서 있었어.

4️⃣ Underneath, I found the smooth black rock nestled among the stones.
   [해석] 나무 밑 돌 틈 사이에 다소곳이 자리 잡은 매끄러운 흑요석 돌을 찾아냈지.

5️⃣ Beneath it lay a small tin box sealed tightly against the elements.
   [해석] 돌 아래에는 빗물이 들어가지 않도록 단단히 밀봉된 작은 틴케이스가 묻혀 있었어.

audio_text: Inside the box was an envelope of cash and a letter from Andy. Dear Red, if you're reading this, you've gotten out. Remember, Red, hope is a good thing, maybe the best of things. And no good thing ever dies. I will be keeping an eye out for you. Your friend, Andy.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 124]

1️⃣ Inside the box was an envelope of cash and a letter from Andy.
   [해석] 상자 안에는 두툼한 현금 봉투와 앤디가 보낸 편지 한 통이 들어 있었지.

2️⃣ Dear Red, if you're reading this, you've gotten out.
   [해석] 친애하는 레드, 자네가 이 글을 읽고 있다면 무사히 밖으로 나왔겠군요.

3️⃣ Remember, Red, hope is a good thing, maybe the best of things.
   [해석] 기억해요, 레드. 희망은 좋은 것입니다. 어쩌면 세상에서 가장 좋은 것일지도 몰라요.

4️⃣ And no good thing ever dies.
   [해석] 그리고 그 어떤 좋은 것도 결코 영원히 죽지 않습니다.

5️⃣ I will be keeping an eye out for you. Your friend, Andy.
   [해석] 자네가 찾아오기를 손꼽아 기다리고 있겠습니다. 자네의 친구, 앤디로부터.

audio_text: I find I'm so excited I can barely sit still or hold a thought in my head. I think it is the excitement only a free man can feel. A free man at the start of a long journey whose conclusion is uncertain. I hope I can make it across the border. I hope to see my friend and shake his hand. I hope the Pacific is as blue as it has been in my dreams. I hope.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 125]

1️⃣ I find I'm so excited I can barely sit still or hold a thought in my head.
   [해석] 얼마나 가슴이 벅차오르는지 가만히 앉아 있을 수도, 생각을 정리할 수도 없더군.

2️⃣ I think it is the excitement only a free man can feel.
   [해석] 오직 자유로운 인간만이 느낄 수 있는 환희와 설렘이라고 생각해.

3️⃣ A free man at the start of a long journey whose conclusion is uncertain.
   [해석] 그 끝을 알 수 없는 기나긴 여정의 출발선에 선 온전한 자유인.

4️⃣ I hope I can make it across the border. I hope to see my friend and shake his hand.
   [해석] 부디 무사히 국경을 넘을 수 있기를 희망한다. 내 오랜 친구를 만나 그 손을 꼭 잡을 수 있기를 희망한다.

5️⃣ I hope the Pacific is as blue as it has been in my dreams. I hope.
   [해석] 태평양이 내 꿈속에서처럼 언제나 눈부시게 푸르기를 희망한다. 나는 희망한다.

audio_text: Mr. Dufresne, describe the confrontation you had with your wife the night she was murdered. It was very bitter. She said she was glad I knew, that she hated all the sneaking around. She said she wanted a divorce in Reno. What was your response? I told her I would not grant one. I'll see you in hell before I see you in Reno.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 126]

1️⃣ Mr. Dufresne, describe the confrontation you had with your wife the night she was murdered.
   [해석] 듀프레인 씨, 아내가 살해당하던 날 밤 있었던 말다툼에 대해 진술해 주십시오.

2️⃣ It was very bitter. She said she was glad I knew, that she hated all the sneaking around.
   [해석] 매우 격렬했습니다. 아내는 내가 알게 되어 차라리 후련하다고, 몰래 숨어다니는 짓에 진절머리가 났다고 했습니다.

3️⃣ She said she wanted a divorce in Reno.
   [해석] 아내는 리노에 가서 이혼하길 원한다고 말했습니다.

4️⃣ What was your response?
   [해석] 당신의 반응은 어땠습니까?

5️⃣ I told her I would not grant one. I'll see you in hell before I see you in Reno.
   [해석] 이혼해 줄 수 없다고 했습니다. 리노에 가느니 지옥에나 가라고 했죠.

audio_text: After she packed her bags and left, what did you do? I went into the kitchen and did some drinking. Later I decided to take a drive. I went to the cottage to confront them. They weren't there, so I parked the car and waited.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 127]

1️⃣ After she packed her bags and left, what did you do?
   [해석] 아내가 짐을 싸서 떠난 후, 당신은 무엇을 했습니까?

2️⃣ I went into the kitchen and did some drinking.
   [해석] 부엌으로 가서 술을 좀 마셨습니다.

3️⃣ Later I decided to take a drive.
   [해석] 그러다 나중에 차를 몰고 나갔습니다.

4️⃣ I went to the cottage to confront them.
   [해석] 두 사람을 담판 짓기 위해 별장으로 갔습니다.

5️⃣ They weren't there, so I parked the car and waited.
   [해석] 그들이 없어서, 차를 세워두고 기다렸습니다.

audio_text: When they arrived, did you go inside? No, I was sobering up. I realized it was pointless. I got back in my car and drove home. And what did you do with the revolver you bought just days before? I threw it into the Royal River. I feel very strongly about that.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 128]

1️⃣ When they arrived, did you go inside?
   [해석] 그들이 도착했을 때, 안으로 들어갔습니까?

2️⃣ No, I was sobering up. I realized it was pointless.
   [해석] 아닙니다, 술이 깨고 있었습니다. 부질없는 짓이라는 걸 깨달았죠.

3️⃣ I got back in my car and drove home.
   [해석] 다시 차에 올라타 집으로 운전해 돌아왔습니다.

4️⃣ And what did you do with the revolver you bought just days before?
   [해석] 그렇다면 며칠 전에 구입한 그 리볼버 권총은 어떻게 했습니까?

5️⃣ I threw it into the Royal River. I feel very strongly about that.
   [해석] 로열 강에 던져 버렸습니다. 그 점은 분명히 기억합니다.

audio_text: The police dragged that river for three days and found no weapon. You strike me as a particularly cold and remorseless man, Mr. Dufresne. It chills my blood just to look at you. By the power vested in me by the state of Maine, I sentence you to two life sentences. Back to back, one for each of your victims.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 129]

1️⃣ The police dragged that river for three days and found no weapon.
   [해석] 경찰이 사흘 동안 그 강을 샅샅이 뒤졌으나 총기는 발견되지 않았습니다.

2️⃣ You strike me as a particularly cold and remorseless man, Mr. Dufresne.
   [해석] 듀프레인 씨, 당신은 유독 차갑고 죄책감이 없는 사람처럼 보입니다.

3️⃣ It chills my blood just to look at you.
   [해석] 당신을 쳐다보는 것만으로도 소름이 끼치는군요.

4️⃣ By the power vested in me by the state of Maine, I sentence you to two life sentences.
   [해석] 메인주가 부여한 권한으로, 피고에게 무기징역 2회를 선고합니다.

5️⃣ Back to back, one for each of your victims.
   [해석] 각 희생자에 대해 하나씩, 연속으로 복역하도록 판결합니다.

audio_text: There's a guy like me in every state and federal prison in America. I'm the guy who can get it for you. Cigarettes, a bag of weed, a bottle of brandy to celebrate your kid's graduation. Yes, sir, I'm a regular Sears and Roebuck. I was convicted of murder when I was just twenty years old.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 130]

1️⃣ There's a guy like me in every state and federal prison in America.
   [해석] 미국의 모든 주립 및 연방 교도소에는 나 같은 놈이 하나씩 있지.

2️⃣ I'm the guy who can get it for you.
   [해석] 원하는 게 있으면 무엇이든 구해줄 수 있는 놈 말이야.

3️⃣ Cigarettes, a bag of weed, a bottle of brandy to celebrate your kid's graduation.
   [해석] 담배, 대마초 한 봉지, 자식의 졸업을 축하하기 위한 브랜디 한 병까지.

4️⃣ Yes, sir, I'm a regular Sears and Roebuck.
   [해석] 그렇고말고, 난 교도소 안의 걸어 다니는 백화점이었지.

5️⃣ I was convicted of murder when I was just twenty years old.
   [해석] 난 고작 스무 살 나이에 살인죄로 유죄 판결을 받았어.

audio_text: I remember my first night in Shawshank like it was yesterday. The new arrivals are always frightened half to death. They march you in naked as the day you were born. Louse powder stinging your skin and eyes. You're locked in a dark cage and suddenly realize this is your new life.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 131]

1️⃣ I remember my first night in Shawshank like it was yesterday.
   [해석] 쇼생크에서의 첫날밤이 마치 어제 일처럼 생생하게 기억나.

2️⃣ The new arrivals are always frightened half to death.
   [해석] 새로 들어온 신참들은 항상 거의 반쯤 넋이 나가 겁에 질려 있지.

3️⃣ They march you in naked as the day you were born.
   [해석] 세상에 태어난 첫날처럼 홀딱 벗겨진 채로 걸어가게 해.

4️⃣ Louse powder stinging your skin and eyes.
   [해석] 이 잡는 소독약 가루가 피부와 눈을 사정없이 따갑게 찌르지.

5️⃣ You're locked in a dark cage and suddenly realize this is your new life.
   [해석] 어두운 쇠창살 방에 갇히고 나면, 비로소 이것이 자신의 새로운 삶임을 깨닫게 돼.

audio_text: I understand you're a man who knows how to get things. I've been known to locate certain things from time to time. What do you want, Dufresne? A hammer? What kind? A rock hammer, about six or seven inches long, for shaping minerals. If you want a toothbrush, I can get that. A rock hammer takes a little more doing.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 132]

1️⃣ I understand you're a man who knows how to get things.
   [해석] 원하는 물건을 구할 줄 아는 분이라고 들었습니다.

2️⃣ I've been known to locate certain things from time to time.
   [해석] 이따금씩 몇 가지 물건들을 구해다 주곤 하지.

3️⃣ What do you want, Dufresne? A hammer? What kind?
   [해석] 뭘 원하는데, 듀프레인? 망치라고? 어떤 종류?

4️⃣ A rock hammer, about six or seven inches long, for shaping minerals.
   [해석] 돌망치입니다. 광물을 다듬기 위한 6~7인치 정도 크기예요.

5️⃣ If you want a toothbrush, I can get that. A rock hammer takes a little more doing.
   [해석] 칫솔이라면 당장 구해줄 수 있지만, 돌망치는 손이 좀 더 많이 가겠는데.

audio_text: Outdoor detail in the springtime is a rare privilege. We were spreading bubbling black tar on the plate factory roof. Captain Hadley was complaining about the taxes on an inheritance. The government takes half of everything, he cursed under his breath. That's when Andy Dufresne stepped right up to the line.
text:

   [해석] 우리는 번호판 공장 지붕 위에 펄펄 끓는 검은 타르를 바르고 있었어.

   [해석] 하들리 간수장은 형제에게 물려받은 유산 상속세 때문에 투덜대고 있었지.

4️⃣ The government takes half of everything, he cursed under his breath.
   [해석] 정부 놈들이 절반이나 뜯어간다고 욕설을 내뱉더군.

5️⃣ That's when Andy Dufresne stepped right up to the line.
   [해석] 바로 그때, 앤디 듀프레인이 성큼 그 앞으로 걸어 나갔어.

audio_text: Mr. Hadley, do you trust your wife? What did you say to me, convict? You want to be tossed off this roof? If you trust her, you can give that thirty-five thousand dollars to her tax-free. The IRS allows a one-time gift to a spouse without paying a single dime. You need someone to set up the paperwork, and I can do it for you.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 134]

   [해석] 뭐라고 지껄였냐, 죄수 놈아? 이 지붕에서 내던져지고 싶어?

   [해석] 아내분을 믿으신다면, 그 3만 5천 달러를 한 푼의 세금도 없이 아내 명의로 넘길 수 있습니다.

4️⃣ The IRS allows a one-time gift to a spouse without paying a single dime.
   [해석] 국세청 규정상 배우자에게 하는 일회성 증여는 단 1센트의 세금도 물리지 않거든요.

5️⃣ You need someone to set up the paperwork, and I can do it for you.
   [해석] 서류 작업을 해줄 사람이 필요하실 텐데, 제가 대신해 드릴 수 있습니다.

audio_text: All I ask is three beers apiece for each of my co-workers. A man working outdoors feels more like a man if he can have a bottle of suds. And so that's how it came to pass. We sat and drank with the sun on our shoulders and felt like free men. Andy sat apart from us, squinting against the light, smiling to himself.
text:

   [해석] 야외에서 땀 흘려 일하는 남자는 시원한 맥주 한 잔을 마실 수 있을 때 비로소 사람답게 느끼는 법이니까요.

   [해석] 그렇게 해서 그 일이 실제로 벌어졌지.

   [해석] 우리는 어깨 위로 따스한 햇살을 받으며 앉아 마치 자유인이 된 기분으로 맥주를 마셨어.

5️⃣ Andy sat apart from us, squinting against the light, smiling to himself.
   [해석] 앤디는 우리와 조금 떨어진 채, 햇빛을 찌푸려 보며 혼자 조용히 미소 짓고 있었지.

audio_text: Andy was reassigned to the prison library assisting old Brooks Hatlen. It was really just a cover for doing taxes for the guards. Word spreads fast, and soon guards from other prisons were coming too. Andy began writing letters to the state senate requesting book funds. He wrote a letter a week for six long years without giving up.
text:

   [해석] 앤디는 늙은 브룩스 영감을 돕는 교도소 도서관 보조로 보직이 변경되었어.

2️⃣ It was really just a cover for doing taxes for the guards.
   [해석] 사실 그건 간수들의 세금 계산을 도맡아 해주기 위한 구실에 불과했지.

3️⃣ Word spreads fast, and soon guards from other prisons were coming too.
   [해석] 소문은 금세 퍼졌고, 머지않아 다른 교도소의 간수들까지 찾아오기 시작했어.

   [해석] 앤디는 주 의회에 도서관 지원금을 요청하는 편지를 매주 쓰기 시작했지.

5️⃣ He wrote a letter a week for six long years without giving up.
   [해석] 포기하지 않고 장장 6년 동안 매주 한 통씩 편지를 써 보냈어.

audio_text: Brooks Hatlen spent fifty years behind these walls. These walls are funny. First you hate them, then you get used to them. Enough time passes, you get so you depend on them. That's institutionalized. Outside, he was nothing, a nobody. Brooks carved his name into the wooden beam: 'Brooks was here.'
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 137]

1️⃣ Brooks Hatlen spent fifty years behind these walls.
   [해석] 브룩스 헤이틀런은 이 담장 안에서 무려 50년의 세월을 보냈어.

2️⃣ These walls are funny. First you hate them, then you get used to them.
   [해석] 이 벽이란 게 참 묘하지. 처음엔 증오하다가도, 점차 익숙해져.

3️⃣ Enough time passes, you get so you depend on them.
   [해석] 세월이 충분히 흐르고 나면, 나중엔 이 벽에 완전히 의존하게 돼버려.

4️⃣ That's institutionalized. Outside, he was nothing, a nobody.
   [해석] 그게 바로 '길들여진다(institutionalized)'는 거야. 담장 밖 세상에서 그는 그저 아무것도 아닌 노인일 뿐이었지.

5️⃣ Brooks carved his name into the wooden beam: 'Brooks was here.'
   [해석] 브룩스는 여관방 나무 들보에 자신의 이름을 새겼어. '브룩스 여기 머물다 가다.'

audio_text: A shipment arrived from the senate containing second-hand books and records. Andy locked the guard in the bathroom and took over the PA system. He put the needle on the turntable, The Marriage of Figaro. Two Italian women singing like birds, soaring high above our gray prison. For the briefest of moments, every last man in Shawshank felt free.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 138]

1️⃣ A shipment arrived from the senate containing second-hand books and records.
   [해석] 의회로부터 헌책들과 낡은 레코드판이 담긴 상자가 도착했어.

2️⃣ Andy locked the guard in the bathroom and took over the PA system.
   [해석] 앤디는 당직 간수를 화장실에 가두고 교도소 방송실을 장악했지.

3️⃣ He put the needle on the turntable, The Marriage of Figaro.
   [해석] 그는 턴테이블 위에 바늘을 올려놓았어. 모차르트의 '피가로의 결혼'이었지.

4️⃣ Two Italian women singing like birds, soaring high above our gray prison.
   [해석] 두 이탈리아 여인의 노랫소리가 마치 새처럼, 잿빛 교도소 담장 위로 아득히 날아올랐어.

5️⃣ For the briefest of moments, every last man in Shawshank felt free.
   [해석] 그 짧은 순간 동안만큼은, 쇼생크의 모든 죄수가 온전한 자유를 느꼈지.

audio_text: Warden Norton gave Andy two weeks in solitary confinement for that stunt. Was it worth two weeks in the hole, Andy? Easiest time I ever did. I had Mr. Mozart with me. They can't get inside your head, Red. There's a place they can't touch. That place is hope. Hope is a good thing, maybe the best of things.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 139]

1️⃣ Warden Norton gave Andy two weeks in solitary confinement for that stunt.
   [해석] 노튼 소장은 그 대가로 앤디에게 2주간의 독방 감금 처벌을 내렸어.

2️⃣ Was it worth two weeks in the hole, Andy?
   [해석] 독방에서 2주나 썩을 만큼 가치가 있었나, 앤디?

3️⃣ Easiest time I ever did. I had Mr. Mozart with me.
   [해석] 내 생애 가장 수월한 시간이었어. 모차르트 선생이 나와 함께 있었거든.

4️⃣ They can't get inside your head, Red. There's a place they can't touch.
   [해석] 그들이 사람의 머릿속까지 들어올 순 없잖아, 레드. 그들이 결코 건드릴 수 없는 곳이 있어.

5️⃣ That place is hope. Hope is a good thing, maybe the best of things.
   [해석] 그곳이 바로 희망이야. 희망은 좋은 거지, 어쩌면 가장 좋은 것일지도 몰라.

audio_text: Warden Norton used prison labor for government road contracts. Bribes and kickbacks poured in from contractors in brown envelopes. Andy funneled the dirty money into clean bank accounts under a ghost identity. A young thief named Tommy Williams arrived with a story to tell. He knew the man who actually murdered Andy's wife and her lover.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 140]

1️⃣ Warden Norton used prison labor for government road contracts.
   [해석] 노튼 소장은 주정부 도로 공사에 죄수들의 무료 노동력을 동원했어.

2️⃣ Bribes and kickbacks poured in from contractors in brown envelopes.
   [해석] 업자들로부터 뇌물과 리베이트가 갈색 서류봉투에 가득 담겨 쏟아져 들어왔지.

   [해석] 앤디는 가상의 유령 신분을 만들어 그 더러운 돈을 깨끗한 은행 계좌들로 빼돌렸어.

   [해석] 토미 윌리엄스라는 젊은 도둑이 들어왔고, 충격적인 이야기를 털어놓았지.

   [해석] 그는 앤디의 아내와 애인을 실제로 살해한 진짜 범인을 알고 있었어.

audio_text: Andy begged Norton for a retrial based on Tommy's testimony. Norton refused coldly, terrified of losing his financial architect. Norton had Tommy called out to the yard in the middle of the night. Hadley shot Tommy four times from the guard tower. They claimed he was attempting to escape. The case was buried forever.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 141]

   [해석] 자신의 돈세탁 관리자를 잃는 것이 두려웠던 노튼은 차갑게 거절했지.

   [해석] 노튼은 한밤중에 토미를 교도소 운동장으로 불러냈어.

   [해석] 그리고 하들리 간수가 감시탑 위에서 토미에게 네 발의 총탄을 난사했지.

5️⃣ They claimed he was attempting to escape. The case was buried forever.
   [해석] 그들은 녀석이 탈옥을 시도했다고 발표했어. 진실은 영원히 묻혀버렸지.

audio_text: Do you know what the Mexicans say about the Pacific? They say it has no memory. That's where I want to live. A little warm town called Zihuatanejo, right on the coast. I'd buy a worthless old boat and fix it up brand new. Get busy living, or get busy dying. That's the choice we have.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 142]

1️⃣ Do you know what the Mexicans say about the Pacific?
   [해석] 멕시코 사람들이 태평양에 대해 뭐라고 하는지 아나, 레드?

   [해석] 과거를 기억하지 않는 곳이라고 하지. 난 바로 그곳에서 살고 싶어.

   [해석] 바쁘게 살아가든가, 아니면 바쁘게 죽어가든가. 우리에게 남은 선택은 그것뿐이야.

audio_text: Red, promise me something if you ever get out of here. There's a big hayfield up in Buxton with a long stone wall. Under a big oak tree, look for a black obsidian rock. There's something buried there meant for you.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 143]

1️⃣ Red, promise me something if you ever get out of here.
   [해석] 레드, 만약 언젠가 이곳을 나가게 된다면 내게 하나만 약속해 줘.

2️⃣ There's a big hayfield up in Buxton with a long stone wall.
   [해석] 벅스턴에 가면 긴 돌담이 둘러쳐진 커다란 건초 밭이 하나 있어.

3️⃣ Under a big oak tree, look for a black obsidian rock.
   [해석] 커다란 오크나무 아래에서, 까맣고 매끄러운 흑요석 돌을 찾아봐.

4️⃣ There's something buried there meant for you.
   [해석] 그 아래 자네를 위해 묻어둔 물건이 있을 테니까.

audio_text: The next morning, cell block five fell dead silent. Andy Dufresne failed to respond to the morning roll call. Warden Norton stormed into the cell in sheer fury. He threw a chess piece at the Rita Hayworth poster on the wall. The stone tore straight through the poster, revealing a pitch-black tunnel.

   [해석] 다음 날 아침, 제5 감방 구역은 쥐 죽은 듯 조용해졌어.

4️⃣ He threw a chess piece at the Rita Hayworth poster on the wall.
   [해석] 그는 분노에 차서 체스 말을 벽에 걸린 리타 헤이워스 포스터로 집어던졌지.

5️⃣ The stone tore straight through the poster, revealing a pitch-black tunnel.
   [해석] 돌은 포스터를 찢고 허공 속으로 날아갔고, 칠흑같이 어두운 굴이 드러났어.

audio_text: Andy had crawled through five hundred yards of foulness. A river of shit smelling of pure rot and despair. Five hundred yards, the length of five football fields. He came out clean on the other side, stripped into the rain. Raising his arms to the heavens, Andy Dufresne was a free man.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 145]

1️⃣ Andy had crawled through five hundred yards of foulness.
   [해석] 앤디는 오백 야드에 달하는 끔찍하고 더러운 오물 파이프를 기어 통과했어.

2️⃣ A river of shit smelling of pure rot and despair.
   [해석] 온갖 부패와 절망의 악취가 진동하는 분뇨의 강을 뚫고 지나간 거지.

3️⃣ Five hundred yards, the length of five football fields.
   [해석] 미식축구장 다섯 개에 달하는 그 길고 지독한 거리를.

   [해석] 그는 마침내 반대편으로 깨끗하게 빠져나와 쏟아지는 빗속에서 옷을 벗어 던졌어.

5️⃣ Raising his arms to the heavens, Andy Dufresne was a free man.
   [해석] 하늘을 향해 두 팔을 번쩍 치켜든 앤디 듀프레인은 드디어 온전한 자유인이었지.

audio_text: The next morning, a distinguished gentleman walked into the Maine National Bank. He withdrew over three hundred and seventy thousand dollars in cash. He also mailed the ledger detailing Warden Norton's corruption to the daily newspaper. Police sirens wailed outside the prison gates as state troopers arrived. Warden Norton loaded his gun, put it under his chin, and pulled the trigger.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 146]

1️⃣ The next morning, a distinguished gentleman walked into the Maine National Bank.
   [해석] 다음 날 아침, 기품 있는 신사 한 명이 메인 국립은행 안으로 걸어 들어왔어.

2️⃣ He withdrew over three hundred and seventy thousand dollars in cash.
   [해석] 그는 37만 달러가 넘는 거액의 비자금을 현금으로 인출했지.

3️⃣ He also mailed the ledger detailing Warden Norton's corruption to the daily newspaper.
   [해석] 동시에 노튼 소장의 모든 부정부패가 기록된 비밀 장부를 일간 신문사로 우편 발송했어.

4️⃣ Police sirens wailed outside the prison gates as state troopers arrived.
   [해석] 주 경찰들이 들이닥치며 교도소 정문 밖으로 경찰 사이렌 소리가 요란하게 울려 퍼졌지.

5️⃣ Warden Norton loaded his gun, put it under his chin, and pulled the trigger.
   [해석] 노튼 소장은 총에 실탄을 장전해 턱 밑에 대고 방아쇠를 당겼어.

audio_text: After forty long years, my parole was finally approved. Forty years I've been asking myself if I'm rehabilitated. It's just a politician's word, meaningless to an old man. I walked out of those gates and felt lost in a world that got fast. I had to pack my bag and keep a promise I made to a friend.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 147]

1️⃣ After forty long years, my parole was finally approved.
   [해석] 장장 40년의 세월이 흐른 뒤, 마침내 나의 가석방이 승인되었어.

2️⃣ Forty years I've been asking myself if I'm rehabilitated.
   [해석] 40년 동안 난 내가 교화되었는지 스스로에게 끊임없이 물어왔지.

3️⃣ It's just a politician's word, meaningless to an old man.
   [해석] 그건 그저 정치가들이나 쓰는 말일 뿐, 늙은이에겐 아무 의미도 없지만 말이야.

4️⃣ I walked out of those gates and felt lost in a world that got fast.
   [해석] 난 교도소 정문을 걸어 나왔지만, 너무 빨라져 버린 세상 속에서 길을 잃은 기분이었어.

5️⃣ I had to pack my bag and keep a promise I made to a friend.
   [해석] 하지만 난 가방을 싸야 했어, 친구와 나눈 소중한 약속을 지키기 위해서.

audio_text: I hitched a ride to Buxton and walked until I found the field. The long stone wall stretched along the green grass under a clear blue sky. There stood the giant oak tree, standing tall just like Andy said. Underneath, I found the smooth black rock nestled among the stones. Beneath it lay a small tin box sealed tightly against the elements.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 148]

1️⃣ I hitched a ride to Buxton and walked until I found the field.
   [해석] 히치하이킹으로 벅스턴까지 가서 그 들판을 찾을 때까지 걸었지.

2️⃣ The long stone wall stretched along the green grass under a clear blue sky.
   [해석] 청명한 푸른 하늘 아래, 긴 돌담이 푸른 초원을 따라 길게 뻗어 있었어.

3️⃣ There stood the giant oak tree, standing tall just like Andy said.
   [해석] 그곳에 앤디의 말 그대로 거대한 오크나무 한 그루가 우뚝 서 있었어.

4️⃣ Underneath, I found the smooth black rock nestled among the stones.
   [해석] 나무 밑 돌 틈 사이에 다소곳이 자리 잡은 매끄러운 흑요석 돌을 찾아냈지.

5️⃣ Beneath it lay a small tin box sealed tightly against the elements.
   [해석] 돌 아래에는 빗물이 들어가지 않도록 단단히 밀봉된 작은 틴케이스가 묻혀 있었어.

audio_text: Inside the box was an envelope of cash and a letter from Andy. Dear Red, if you're reading this, you've gotten out. Remember, Red, hope is a good thing, maybe the best of things. And no good thing ever dies. I will be keeping an eye out for you. Your friend, Andy.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 149]

1️⃣ Inside the box was an envelope of cash and a letter from Andy.
   [해석] 상자 안에는 두툼한 현금 봉투와 앤디가 보낸 편지 한 통이 들어 있었지.

2️⃣ Dear Red, if you're reading this, you've gotten out.
   [해석] 친애하는 레드, 자네가 이 글을 읽고 있다면 무사히 밖으로 나왔겠군요.

3️⃣ Remember, Red, hope is a good thing, maybe the best of things.
   [해석] 기억해요, 레드. 희망은 좋은 것입니다. 어쩌면 세상에서 가장 좋은 것일지도 몰라요.

4️⃣ And no good thing ever dies.
   [해석] 그리고 그 어떤 좋은 것도 결코 영원히 죽지 않습니다.

5️⃣ I will be keeping an eye out for you. Your friend, Andy.
   [해석] 자네가 찾아오기를 손꼽아 기다리고 있겠습니다. 자네의 친구, 앤디로부터.

audio_text: I find I'm so excited I can barely sit still or hold a thought in my head. I think it is the excitement only a free man can feel. A free man at the start of a long journey whose conclusion is uncertain. I hope I can make it across the border. I hope to see my friend and shake his hand. I hope the Pacific is as blue as it has been in my dreams. I hope.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 150]

1️⃣ I find I'm so excited I can barely sit still or hold a thought in my head.
   [해석] 얼마나 가슴이 벅차오르는지 가만히 앉아 있을 수도, 생각을 정리할 수도 없더군.

2️⃣ I think it is the excitement only a free man can feel.
   [해석] 오직 자유로운 인간만이 느낄 수 있는 환희와 설렘이라고 생각해.

3️⃣ A free man at the start of a long journey whose conclusion is uncertain.
   [해석] 그 끝을 알 수 없는 기나긴 여정의 출발선에 선 온전한 자유인.

4️⃣ I hope I can make it across the border. I hope to see my friend and shake his hand.
   [해석] 부디 무사히 국경을 넘을 수 있기를 희망한다. 내 오랜 친구를 만나 그 손을 꼭 잡을 수 있기를 희망한다.

5️⃣ I hope the Pacific is as blue as it has been in my dreams. I hope.
   [해석] 태평양이 내 꿈속에서처럼 언제나 눈부시게 푸르기를 희망한다. 나는 희망한다.

audio_text: Mr. Dufresne, describe the confrontation you had with your wife the night she was murdered. It was very bitter. She said she was glad I knew, that she hated all the sneaking around. She said she wanted a divorce in Reno. What was your response? I told her I would not grant one. I'll see you in hell before I see you in Reno.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 151]

1️⃣ Mr. Dufresne, describe the confrontation you had with your wife the night she was murdered.
   [해석] 듀프레인 씨, 아내가 살해당하던 날 밤 있었던 말다툼에 대해 진술해 주십시오.

2️⃣ It was very bitter. She said she was glad I knew, that she hated all the sneaking around.
   [해석] 매우 격렬했습니다. 아내는 내가 알게 되어 차라리 후련하다고, 몰래 숨어다니는 짓에 진절머리가 났다고 했습니다.

3️⃣ She said she wanted a divorce in Reno.
   [해석] 아내는 리노에 가서 이혼하길 원한다고 말했습니다.

4️⃣ What was your response?
   [해석] 당신의 반응은 어땠습니까?

5️⃣ I told her I would not grant one. I'll see you in hell before I see you in Reno.
   [해석] 이혼해 줄 수 없다고 했습니다. 리노에 가느니 지옥에나 가라고 했죠.

audio_text: After she packed her bags and left, what did you do? I went into the kitchen and did some drinking. Later I decided to take a drive. I went to the cottage to confront them. They weren't there, so I parked the car and waited.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 152]

1️⃣ After she packed her bags and left, what did you do?
   [해석] 아내가 짐을 싸서 떠난 후, 당신은 무엇을 했습니까?

2️⃣ I went into the kitchen and did some drinking.
   [해석] 부엌으로 가서 술을 좀 마셨습니다.

3️⃣ Later I decided to take a drive.
   [해석] 그러다 나중에 차를 몰고 나갔습니다.

4️⃣ I went to the cottage to confront them.
   [해석] 두 사람을 담판 짓기 위해 별장으로 갔습니다.

5️⃣ They weren't there, so I parked the car and waited.
   [해석] 그들이 없어서, 차를 세워두고 기다렸습니다.

audio_text: When they arrived, did you go inside? No, I was sobering up. I realized it was pointless. I got back in my car and drove home. And what did you do with the revolver you bought just days before? I threw it into the Royal River. I feel very strongly about that.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 153]

1️⃣ When they arrived, did you go inside?
   [해석] 그들이 도착했을 때, 안으로 들어갔습니까?

2️⃣ No, I was sobering up. I realized it was pointless.
   [해석] 아닙니다, 술이 깨고 있었습니다. 부질없는 짓이라는 걸 깨달았죠.

3️⃣ I got back in my car and drove home.
   [해석] 다시 차에 올라타 집으로 운전해 돌아왔습니다.

4️⃣ And what did you do with the revolver you bought just days before?
   [해석] 그렇다면 며칠 전에 구입한 그 리볼버 권총은 어떻게 했습니까?

5️⃣ I threw it into the Royal River. I feel very strongly about that.
   [해석] 로열 강에 던져 버렸습니다. 그 점은 분명히 기억합니다.

audio_text: The police dragged that river for three days and found no weapon. You strike me as a particularly cold and remorseless man, Mr. Dufresne. It chills my blood just to look at you. By the power vested in me by the state of Maine, I sentence you to two life sentences. Back to back, one for each of your victims.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 154]

1️⃣ The police dragged that river for three days and found no weapon.
   [해석] 경찰이 사흘 동안 그 강을 샅샅이 뒤졌으나 총기는 발견되지 않았습니다.

2️⃣ You strike me as a particularly cold and remorseless man, Mr. Dufresne.
   [해석] 듀프레인 씨, 당신은 유독 차갑고 죄책감이 없는 사람처럼 보입니다.

3️⃣ It chills my blood just to look at you.
   [해석] 당신을 쳐다보는 것만으로도 소름이 끼치는군요.

4️⃣ By the power vested in me by the state of Maine, I sentence you to two life sentences.
   [해석] 메인주가 부여한 권한으로, 피고에게 무기징역 2회를 선고합니다.

5️⃣ Back to back, one for each of your victims.
   [해석] 각 희생자에 대해 하나씩, 연속으로 복역하도록 판결합니다.

audio_text: There's a guy like me in every state and federal prison in America. I'm the guy who can get it for you. Cigarettes, a bag of weed, a bottle of brandy to celebrate your kid's graduation. Yes, sir, I'm a regular Sears and Roebuck. I was convicted of murder when I was just twenty years old.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 155]

1️⃣ There's a guy like me in every state and federal prison in America.
   [해석] 미국의 모든 주립 및 연방 교도소에는 나 같은 놈이 하나씩 있지.

2️⃣ I'm the guy who can get it for you.
   [해석] 원하는 게 있으면 무엇이든 구해줄 수 있는 놈 말이야.

3️⃣ Cigarettes, a bag of weed, a bottle of brandy to celebrate your kid's graduation.
   [해석] 담배, 대마초 한 봉지, 자식의 졸업을 축하하기 위한 브랜디 한 병까지.

4️⃣ Yes, sir, I'm a regular Sears and Roebuck.
   [해석] 그렇고말고, 난 교도소 안의 걸어 다니는 백화점이었지.

5️⃣ I was convicted of murder when I was just twenty years old.
   [해석] 난 고작 스무 살 나이에 살인죄로 유죄 판결을 받았어.

audio_text: I remember my first night in Shawshank like it was yesterday. The new arrivals are always frightened half to death. They march you in naked as the day you were born. Louse powder stinging your skin and eyes. You're locked in a dark cage and suddenly realize this is your new life.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 156]

1️⃣ I remember my first night in Shawshank like it was yesterday.
   [해석] 쇼생크에서의 첫날밤이 마치 어제 일처럼 생생하게 기억나.

2️⃣ The new arrivals are always frightened half to death.
   [해석] 새로 들어온 신참들은 항상 거의 반쯤 넋이 나가 겁에 질려 있지.

3️⃣ They march you in naked as the day you were born.
   [해석] 세상에 태어난 첫날처럼 홀딱 벗겨진 채로 걸어가게 해.

4️⃣ Louse powder stinging your skin and eyes.
   [해석] 이 잡는 소독약 가루가 피부와 눈을 사정없이 따갑게 찌르지.

5️⃣ You're locked in a dark cage and suddenly realize this is your new life.
   [해석] 어두운 쇠창살 방에 갇히고 나면, 비로소 이것이 자신의 새로운 삶임을 깨닫게 돼.

audio_text: I understand you're a man who knows how to get things. I've been known to locate certain things from time to time. What do you want, Dufresne? A hammer? What kind? A rock hammer, about six or seven inches long, for shaping minerals. If you want a toothbrush, I can get that. A rock hammer takes a little more doing.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 157]

1️⃣ I understand you're a man who knows how to get things.
   [해석] 원하는 물건을 구할 줄 아는 분이라고 들었습니다.

2️⃣ I've been known to locate certain things from time to time.
   [해석] 이따금씩 몇 가지 물건들을 구해다 주곤 하지.

3️⃣ What do you want, Dufresne? A hammer? What kind?
   [해석] 뭘 원하는데, 듀프레인? 망치라고? 어떤 종류?

4️⃣ A rock hammer, about six or seven inches long, for shaping minerals.
   [해석] 돌망치입니다. 광물을 다듬기 위한 6~7인치 정도 크기예요.

5️⃣ If you want a toothbrush, I can get that. A rock hammer takes a little more doing.
   [해석] 칫솔이라면 당장 구해줄 수 있지만, 돌망치는 손이 좀 더 많이 가겠는데.

audio_text: Outdoor detail in the springtime is a rare privilege. We were spreading bubbling black tar on the plate factory roof. Captain Hadley was complaining about the taxes on an inheritance. The government takes half of everything, he cursed under his breath. That's when Andy Dufresne stepped right up to the line.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 158]

1️⃣ Outdoor detail in the springtime is a rare privilege.
   [해석] 화창한 봄날의 야외 작업은 교도소에서 드문 특권이지.

2️⃣ We were spreading bubbling black tar on the plate factory roof.
   [해석] 우리는 번호판 공장 지붕 위에 펄펄 끓는 검은 타르를 바르고 있었어.

3️⃣ Captain Hadley was complaining about the taxes on an inheritance.
   [해석] 하들리 간수장은 형제에게 물려받은 유산 상속세 때문에 투덜대고 있었지.

4️⃣ The government takes half of everything, he cursed under his breath.
   [해석] 정부 놈들이 절반이나 뜯어간다고 욕설을 내뱉더군.

5️⃣ That's when Andy Dufresne stepped right up to the line.
   [해석] 바로 그때, 앤디 듀프레인이 성큼 그 앞으로 걸어 나갔어.

audio_text: Mr. Hadley, do you trust your wife? What did you say to me, convict? You want to be tossed off this roof? If you trust her, you can give that thirty-five thousand dollars to her tax-free. The IRS allows a one-time gift to a spouse without paying a single dime. You need someone to set up the paperwork, and I can do it for you.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 159]

1️⃣ Mr. Hadley, do you trust your wife?
   [해석] 하들리 씨, 아내분을 믿으십니까?

2️⃣ What did you say to me, convict? You want to be tossed off this roof?
   [해석] 뭐라고 지껄였냐, 죄수 놈아? 이 지붕에서 내던져지고 싶어?

3️⃣ If you trust her, you can give that thirty-five thousand dollars to her tax-free.
   [해석] 아내분을 믿으신다면, 그 3만 5천 달러를 한 푼의 세금도 없이 아내 명의로 넘길 수 있습니다.

4️⃣ The IRS allows a one-time gift to a spouse without paying a single dime.
   [해석] 국세청 규정상 배우자에게 하는 일회성 증여는 단 1센트의 세금도 물리지 않거든요.

5️⃣ You need someone to set up the paperwork, and I can do it for you.
   [해석] 서류 작업을 해줄 사람이 필요하실 텐데, 제가 대신해 드릴 수 있습니다.

audio_text: All I ask is three beers apiece for each of my co-workers. A man working outdoors feels more like a man if he can have a bottle of suds. And so that's how it came to pass. We sat and drank with the sun on our shoulders and felt like free men. Andy sat apart from us, squinting against the light, smiling to himself.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 160]

1️⃣ All I ask is three beers apiece for each of my co-workers.
   [해석] 제가 부탁드리는 대가는 여기 일하는 동료들에게 차가운 맥주 세 병씩을 주시는 것뿐입니다.

2️⃣ A man working outdoors feels more like a man if he can have a bottle of suds.
   [해석] 야외에서 땀 흘려 일하는 남자는 시원한 맥주 한 잔을 마실 수 있을 때 비로소 사람답게 느끼는 법이니까요.

3️⃣ And so that's how it came to pass.
   [해석] 그렇게 해서 그 일이 실제로 벌어졌지.

4️⃣ We sat and drank with the sun on our shoulders and felt like free men.
   [해석] 우리는 어깨 위로 따스한 햇살을 받으며 앉아 마치 자유인이 된 기분으로 맥주를 마셨어.

5️⃣ Andy sat apart from us, squinting against the light, smiling to himself.
   [해석] 앤디는 우리와 조금 떨어진 채, 햇빛을 찌푸려 보며 혼자 조용히 미소 짓고 있었지.

audio_text: Andy was reassigned to the prison library assisting old Brooks Hatlen. It was really just a cover for doing taxes for the guards. Word spreads fast, and soon guards from other prisons were coming too. Andy began writing letters to the state senate requesting book funds. He wrote a letter a week for six long years without giving up.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 161]

1️⃣ Andy was reassigned to the prison library assisting old Brooks Hatlen.
   [해석] 앤디는 늙은 브룩스 영감을 돕는 교도소 도서관 보조로 보직이 변경되었어.

2️⃣ It was really just a cover for doing taxes for the guards.
   [해석] 사실 그건 간수들의 세금 계산을 도맡아 해주기 위한 구실에 불과했지.

3️⃣ Word spreads fast, and soon guards from other prisons were coming too.
   [해석] 소문은 금세 퍼졌고, 머지않아 다른 교도소의 간수들까지 찾아오기 시작했어.

4️⃣ Andy began writing letters to the state senate requesting book funds.
   [해석] 앤디는 주 의회에 도서관 지원금을 요청하는 편지를 매주 쓰기 시작했지.

5️⃣ He wrote a letter a week for six long years without giving up.
   [해석] 포기하지 않고 장장 6년 동안 매주 한 통씩 편지를 써 보냈어.

audio_text: Brooks Hatlen spent fifty years behind these walls. These walls are funny. First you hate them, then you get used to them. Enough time passes, you get so you depend on them. That's institutionalized. Outside, he was nothing, a nobody. Brooks carved his name into the wooden beam: 'Brooks was here.'
text:

   [해석] 브룩스 헤이틀런은 이 담장 안에서 무려 50년의 세월을 보냈어.

2️⃣ These walls are funny. First you hate them, then you get used to them.
   [해석] 이 벽이란 게 참 묘하지. 처음엔 증오하다가도, 점차 익숙해져.

3️⃣ Enough time passes, you get so you depend on them.
   [해석] 세월이 충분히 흐르고 나면, 나중엔 이 벽에 완전히 의존하게 돼버려.

4️⃣ That's institutionalized. Outside, he was nothing, a nobody.
   [해석] 그게 바로 '길들여진다(institutionalized)'는 거야. 담장 밖 세상에서 그는 그저 아무것도 아닌 노인일 뿐이었지.

5️⃣ Brooks carved his name into the wooden beam: 'Brooks was here.'
   [해석] 브룩스는 여관방 나무 들보에 자신의 이름을 새겼어. '브룩스 여기 머물다 가다.'

audio_text: A shipment arrived from the senate containing second-hand books and records. Andy locked the guard in the bathroom and took over the PA system. He put the needle on the turntable, The Marriage of Figaro. Two Italian women singing like birds, soaring high above our gray prison. For the briefest of moments, every last man in Shawshank felt free.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 163]

   [해석] 의회로부터 헌책들과 낡은 레코드판이 담긴 상자가 도착했어.

2️⃣ Andy locked the guard in the bathroom and took over the PA system.
   [해석] 앤디는 당직 간수를 화장실에 가두고 교도소 방송실을 장악했지.

3️⃣ He put the needle on the turntable, The Marriage of Figaro.
   [해석] 그는 턴테이블 위에 바늘을 올려놓았어. 모차르트의 '피가로의 결혼'이었지.

4️⃣ Two Italian women singing like birds, soaring high above our gray prison.
   [해석] 두 이탈리아 여인의 노랫소리가 마치 새처럼, 잿빛 교도소 담장 위로 아득히 날아올랐어.

5️⃣ For the briefest of moments, every last man in Shawshank felt free.
   [해석] 그 짧은 순간 동안만큼은, 쇼생크의 모든 죄수가 온전한 자유를 느꼈지.

audio_text: Warden Norton gave Andy two weeks in solitary confinement for that stunt. Was it worth two weeks in the hole, Andy? Easiest time I ever did. I had Mr. Mozart with me. They can't get inside your head, Red. There's a place they can't touch. That place is hope. Hope is a good thing, maybe the best of things.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 164]

1️⃣ Warden Norton gave Andy two weeks in solitary confinement for that stunt.
   [해석] 노튼 소장은 그 대가로 앤디에게 2주간의 독방 감금 처벌을 내렸어.

2️⃣ Was it worth two weeks in the hole, Andy?
   [해석] 독방에서 2주나 썩을 만큼 가치가 있었나, 앤디?

3️⃣ Easiest time I ever did. I had Mr. Mozart with me.
   [해석] 내 생애 가장 수월한 시간이었어. 모차르트 선생이 나와 함께 있었거든.

4️⃣ They can't get inside your head, Red. There's a place they can't touch.
   [해석] 그들이 사람의 머릿속까지 들어올 순 없잖아, 레드. 그들이 결코 건드릴 수 없는 곳이 있어.

5️⃣ That place is hope. Hope is a good thing, maybe the best of things.
   [해석] 그곳이 바로 희망이야. 희망은 좋은 거지, 어쩌면 가장 좋은 것일지도 몰라.

audio_text: Warden Norton used prison labor for government road contracts. Bribes and kickbacks poured in from contractors in brown envelopes. Andy funneled the dirty money into clean bank accounts under a ghost identity. A young thief named Tommy Williams arrived with a story to tell. He knew the man who actually murdered Andy's wife and her lover.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 165]

1️⃣ Warden Norton used prison labor for government road contracts.
   [해석] 노튼 소장은 주정부 도로 공사에 죄수들의 무료 노동력을 동원했어.

2️⃣ Bribes and kickbacks poured in from contractors in brown envelopes.
   [해석] 업자들로부터 뇌물과 리베이트가 갈색 서류봉투에 가득 담겨 쏟아져 들어왔지.

3️⃣ Andy funneled the dirty money into clean bank accounts under a ghost identity.
   [해석] 앤디는 가상의 유령 신분을 만들어 그 더러운 돈을 깨끗한 은행 계좌들로 빼돌렸어.

4️⃣ A young thief named Tommy Williams arrived with a story to tell.
   [해석] 토미 윌리엄스라는 젊은 도둑이 들어왔고, 충격적인 이야기를 털어놓았지.

5️⃣ He knew the man who actually murdered Andy's wife and her lover.
   [해석] 그는 앤디의 아내와 애인을 실제로 살해한 진짜 범인을 알고 있었어.

audio_text: Andy begged Norton for a retrial based on Tommy's testimony. Norton refused coldly, terrified of losing his financial architect. Norton had Tommy called out to the yard in the middle of the night. Hadley shot Tommy four times from the guard tower. They claimed he was attempting to escape. The case was buried forever.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 166]

1️⃣ Andy begged Norton for a retrial based on Tommy's testimony.
   [해석] 앤디는 토미의 증언을 토대로 재심을 청구하게 해달라고 노튼에게 간청했어.

2️⃣ Norton refused coldly, terrified of losing his financial architect.
   [해석] 자신의 돈세탁 관리자를 잃는 것이 두려웠던 노튼은 차갑게 거절했지.

3️⃣ Norton had Tommy called out to the yard in the middle of the night.
   [해석] 노튼은 한밤중에 토미를 교도소 운동장으로 불러냈어.

4️⃣ Hadley shot Tommy four times from the guard tower.
   [해석] 그리고 하들리 간수가 감시탑 위에서 토미에게 네 발의 총탄을 난사했지.

5️⃣ They claimed he was attempting to escape. The case was buried forever.
   [해석] 그들은 녀석이 탈옥을 시도했다고 발표했어. 진실은 영원히 묻혀버렸지.

audio_text: Do you know what the Mexicans say about the Pacific? They say it has no memory. That's where I want to live. A little warm town called Zihuatanejo, right on the coast. I'd buy a worthless old boat and fix it up brand new. Get busy living, or get busy dying. That's the choice we have.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 167]

1️⃣ Do you know what the Mexicans say about the Pacific?
   [해석] 멕시코 사람들이 태평양에 대해 뭐라고 하는지 아나, 레드?

2️⃣ They say it has no memory. That's where I want to live.
   [해석] 과거를 기억하지 않는 곳이라고 하지. 난 바로 그곳에서 살고 싶어.

3️⃣ A little warm town called Zihuatanejo, right on the coast.
   [해석] 해안가에 자리 잡은 지후아타네호라는 작고 따뜻한 마을이야.

4️⃣ I'd buy a worthless old boat and fix it up brand new.
   [해석] 헐값의 낡은 보트를 한 척 사서 완전히 새것처럼 수리하는 거지.

5️⃣ Get busy living, or get busy dying. That's the choice we have.
   [해석] 바쁘게 살아가든가, 아니면 바쁘게 죽어가든가. 우리에게 남은 선택은 그것뿐이야.

audio_text: Red, promise me something if you ever get out of here. There's a big hayfield up in Buxton with a long stone wall. Under a big oak tree, look for a black obsidian rock. There's something buried there meant for you.
text:

   [해석] 벅스턴에 가면 긴 돌담이 둘러쳐진 커다란 건초 밭이 하나 있어.

   [해석] 커다란 오크나무 아래에서, 까맣고 매끄러운 흑요석 돌을 찾아봐.

   [해석] 그 아래 자네를 위해 묻어둔 물건이 있을 테니까.

audio_text: The next morning, cell block five fell dead silent. Andy Dufresne failed to respond to the morning roll call. Warden Norton stormed into the cell in sheer fury. He threw a chess piece at the Rita Hayworth poster on the wall. The stone tore straight through the poster, revealing a pitch-black tunnel.

   [해석] 그는 분노에 차서 체스 말을 벽에 걸린 리타 헤이워스 포스터로 집어던졌지.

5️⃣ The stone tore straight through the poster, revealing a pitch-black tunnel.
   [해석] 돌은 포스터를 찢고 허공 속으로 날아갔고, 칠흑같이 어두운 굴이 드러났어.

audio_text: Andy had crawled through five hundred yards of foulness. A river of shit smelling of pure rot and despair. Five hundred yards, the length of five football fields. He came out clean on the other side, stripped into the rain. Raising his arms to the heavens, Andy Dufresne was a free man.

2️⃣ A river of shit smelling of pure rot and despair.
   [해석] 온갖 부패와 절망의 악취가 진동하는 분뇨의 강을 뚫고 지나간 거지.

3️⃣ Five hundred yards, the length of five football fields.
   [해석] 미식축구장 다섯 개에 달하는 그 길고 지독한 거리를.

4️⃣ He came out clean on the other side, stripped into the rain.
   [해석] 그는 마침내 반대편으로 깨끗하게 빠져나와 쏟아지는 빗속에서 옷을 벗어 던졌어.

5️⃣ Raising his arms to the heavens, Andy Dufresne was a free man.
   [해석] 하늘을 향해 두 팔을 번쩍 치켜든 앤디 듀프레인은 드디어 온전한 자유인이었지.

audio_text: The next morning, a distinguished gentleman walked into the Maine National Bank. He withdrew over three hundred and seventy thousand dollars in cash. He also mailed the ledger detailing Warden Norton's corruption to the daily newspaper. Police sirens wailed outside the prison gates as state troopers arrived. Warden Norton loaded his gun, put it under his chin, and pulled the trigger.

2️⃣ He withdrew over three hundred and seventy thousand dollars in cash.
   [해석] 그는 37만 달러가 넘는 거액의 비자금을 현금으로 인출했지.

3️⃣ He also mailed the ledger detailing Warden Norton's corruption to the daily newspaper.
   [해석] 동시에 노튼 소장의 모든 부정부패가 기록된 비밀 장부를 일간 신문사로 우편 발송했어.

4️⃣ Police sirens wailed outside the prison gates as state troopers arrived.
   [해석] 주 경찰들이 들이닥치며 교도소 정문 밖으로 경찰 사이렌 소리가 요란하게 울려 퍼졌지.

   [해석] 노튼 소장은 총에 실탄을 장전해 턱 밑에 대고 방아쇠를 당겼어.

audio_text: After forty long years, my parole was finally approved. Forty years I've been asking myself if I'm rehabilitated. It's just a politician's word, meaningless to an old man. I walked out of those gates and felt lost in a world that got fast. I had to pack my bag and keep a promise I made to a friend.
text:

   [해석] 장장 40년의 세월이 흐른 뒤, 마침내 나의 가석방이 승인되었어.

2️⃣ Forty years I've been asking myself if I'm rehabilitated.
   [해석] 40년 동안 난 내가 교화되었는지 스스로에게 끊임없이 물어왔지.

   [해석] 그건 그저 정치가들이나 쓰는 말일 뿐, 늙은이에겐 아무 의미도 없지만 말이야.

4️⃣ I walked out of those gates and felt lost in a world that got fast.
   [해석] 난 교도소 정문을 걸어 나왔지만, 너무 빨라져 버린 세상 속에서 길을 잃은 기분이었어.

5️⃣ I had to pack my bag and keep a promise I made to a friend.
   [해석] 하지만 난 가방을 싸야 했어, 친구와 나눈 소중한 약속을 지키기 위해서.

audio_text: I hitched a ride to Buxton and walked until I found the field. The long stone wall stretched along the green grass under a clear blue sky. There stood the giant oak tree, standing tall just like Andy said. Underneath, I found the smooth black rock nestled among the stones. Beneath it lay a small tin box sealed tightly against the elements.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 173]

1️⃣ I hitched a ride to Buxton and walked until I found the field.
   [해석] 히치하이킹으로 벅스턴까지 가서 그 들판을 찾을 때까지 걸었지.

2️⃣ The long stone wall stretched along the green grass under a clear blue sky.
   [해석] 청명한 푸른 하늘 아래, 긴 돌담이 푸른 초원을 따라 길게 뻗어 있었어.

3️⃣ There stood the giant oak tree, standing tall just like Andy said.
   [해석] 그곳에 앤디의 말 그대로 거대한 오크나무 한 그루가 우뚝 서 있었어.

4️⃣ Underneath, I found the smooth black rock nestled among the stones.
   [해석] 나무 밑 돌 틈 사이에 다소곳이 자리 잡은 매끄러운 흑요석 돌을 찾아냈지.

5️⃣ Beneath it lay a small tin box sealed tightly against the elements.
   [해석] 돌 아래에는 빗물이 들어가지 않도록 단단히 밀봉된 작은 틴케이스가 묻혀 있었어.

audio_text: Inside the box was an envelope of cash and a letter from Andy. Dear Red, if you're reading this, you've gotten out. Remember, Red, hope is a good thing, maybe the best of things. And no good thing ever dies. I will be keeping an eye out for you. Your friend, Andy.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 174]

1️⃣ Inside the box was an envelope of cash and a letter from Andy.
   [해석] 상자 안에는 두툼한 현금 봉투와 앤디가 보낸 편지 한 통이 들어 있었지.

2️⃣ Dear Red, if you're reading this, you've gotten out.
   [해석] 친애하는 레드, 자네가 이 글을 읽고 있다면 무사히 밖으로 나왔겠군요.

3️⃣ Remember, Red, hope is a good thing, maybe the best of things.
   [해석] 기억해요, 레드. 희망은 좋은 것입니다. 어쩌면 세상에서 가장 좋은 것일지도 몰라요.

4️⃣ And no good thing ever dies.
   [해석] 그리고 그 어떤 좋은 것도 결코 영원히 죽지 않습니다.

5️⃣ I will be keeping an eye out for you. Your friend, Andy.
   [해석] 자네가 찾아오기를 손꼽아 기다리고 있겠습니다. 자네의 친구, 앤디로부터.

audio_text: I find I'm so excited I can barely sit still or hold a thought in my head. I think it is the excitement only a free man can feel. A free man at the start of a long journey whose conclusion is uncertain. I hope I can make it across the border. I hope to see my friend and shake his hand. I hope the Pacific is as blue as it has been in my dreams. I hope.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 175]

   [해석] 얼마나 가슴이 벅차오르는지 가만히 앉아 있을 수도, 생각을 정리할 수도 없더군.

2️⃣ I think it is the excitement only a free man can feel.
   [해석] 오직 자유로운 인간만이 느낄 수 있는 환희와 설렘이라고 생각해.

3️⃣ A free man at the start of a long journey whose conclusion is uncertain.
   [해석] 그 끝을 알 수 없는 기나긴 여정의 출발선에 선 온전한 자유인.

4️⃣ I hope I can make it across the border. I hope to see my friend and shake his hand.
   [해석] 부디 무사히 국경을 넘을 수 있기를 희망한다. 내 오랜 친구를 만나 그 손을 꼭 잡을 수 있기를 희망한다.

5️⃣ I hope the Pacific is as blue as it has been in my dreams. I hope.
   [해석] 태평양이 내 꿈속에서처럼 언제나 눈부시게 푸르기를 희망한다. 나는 희망한다.

audio_text: Mr. Dufresne, describe the confrontation you had with your wife the night she was murdered. It was very bitter. She said she was glad I knew, that she hated all the sneaking around. She said she wanted a divorce in Reno. What was your response? I told her I would not grant one. I'll see you in hell before I see you in Reno.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 176]

1️⃣ Mr. Dufresne, describe the confrontation you had with your wife the night she was murdered.
   [해석] 듀프레인 씨, 아내가 살해당하던 날 밤 있었던 말다툼에 대해 진술해 주십시오.

2️⃣ It was very bitter. She said she was glad I knew, that she hated all the sneaking around.
   [해석] 매우 격렬했습니다. 아내는 내가 알게 되어 차라리 후련하다고, 몰래 숨어다니는 짓에 진절머리가 났다고 했습니다.

3️⃣ She said she wanted a divorce in Reno.
   [해석] 아내는 리노에 가서 이혼하길 원한다고 말했습니다.

4️⃣ What was your response?
   [해석] 당신의 반응은 어땠습니까?

5️⃣ I told her I would not grant one. I'll see you in hell before I see you in Reno.
   [해석] 이혼해 줄 수 없다고 했습니다. 리노에 가느니 지옥에나 가라고 했죠.

audio_text: After she packed her bags and left, what did you do? I went into the kitchen and did some drinking. Later I decided to take a drive. I went to the cottage to confront them. They weren't there, so I parked the car and waited.
text:
🎬 [쇼생크 탈출(The Shawshank Redemption) - Day 177]

1️⃣ After she packed her bags and left, what did you do?
   [해석] 아내가 짐을 싸서 떠난 후, 당신은 무엇을 했습니까?

2️⃣ I went into the kitchen and did some drinking.
   [해석] 부엌으로 가서 술을 좀 마셨습니다.

3️⃣ Later I decided to take a drive.
   [해석] 그러다 나중에 차를 몰고 나갔습니다.

4️⃣ I went to the cottage to confront them.
   [해석] 두 사람을 담판 짓기 위해 별장으로 갔습니다.

5️⃣ They weren't there, so I parked the car and waited.
   [해석] 그들이 없어서, 차를 세워두고 기다렸습니다.
